label: recordingKeys: recording on no longer keys a static fill at the playhead
animatedNeverFlattens: recording off sets the static value of an animated fill
togglingAtThePlayheadAddsAndRemovesAKey: the last key leaves the old static fill
find: if key == .fill { fill = .solid(last.value) } else { stroke?.color = last.value }

label: recordingOnKeysStrokeColourAndWidth: a keyed width also overwrites the static width
find: (writes, stroke.width) = (writes + [.width(a, shape: i, frame: f, edited.width)], kept.width)
replace: writes += [.width(a, shape: i, frame: f, edited.width)]
